Tour Package Overview:
Experience the ultimate in Napa Valley glamour with our exclusive VIP tour package! Book now for a full-day adventure that combines the charm of Napa's top castle wineries with a romantic journey aboard the Napa Valley Wine Train.

Indulge in a 3-hour, elegant dining experience on the historic Napa Valley Wine Train, where you'll step back into the golden age of rail travel. Relish a multi-course gourmet meal in vintage passenger cars, savoring the romance and sophistication of a bygone era.

Enjoy unparalleled views of Napa Valley’s rolling hills and picturesque vineyards as you relax in luxury. With access to both the train’s rustic lounge and sophisticated dining car, you'll experience Napa in the height of style.

Don’t miss out—book your glamorous Napa Valley adventure today!
